title: Political Engine
description:
Political Engine 0.8.0 - Experimental release
AI-driven political correspondence, diplomacy and warfare for SkyrimNet. Exchange letters with jarls, negotiate trade and peace, command troops, and manage territories, resources and buildings through an interactive campaign map.

Continuation of Political Letters: legacy plugin names are preserved for save compatibility. Back up your save before updating.
author: sixteenth
changelog:
### Political Engine 0.8.0 expands Skyrim's political campaign with autonomous NPC wars, ruler-to-ruler correspondence, war coalitions, and gold or resource aid. Realms can recruit, prepare for war, negotiate peace, and establish new governments after conquest.

The update also adds food and army upkeep, configurable turn points, improved campaign maps, persistent troop camps, and political context for soldiers speaking through SkyrimNet. Optional Intel Engine integration adds an event journal, map markers, and experimental scene requests.

Available for **Skyrim SE/AE and VR**, with **PrismaUI or Magelight** and **English or Russian** localization. The release includes an updated developer SDK and a full changelog since 0.7.0.

Full list of changes you can find on GitHub.
